EX12-046.effect_description_eng:
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Give 1 of your opponent's Digimon ＜Security A. -1＞ and -3000 DP until their turn ends.
[Your Turn] When your opponent's security stack is removed from, this Digimon may digivolve into a [TB] trait Digimon card in the hand with the cost reduced by 2.
EX12-046.inherited_effect_description_eng: [End of Attack] [Once Per Turn] You may play 1 [TB] trait Digimon card with 5000 DP or less from your hand without paying the cost.

EX12-063.effect_description_eng:
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers. Then, 1 of their Digimon or Tamers can't unsuspend until their turn ends.
[On Deletion] You may play 1 level 4 or lower [Puppet] or [TB] trait Digimon card from your trash without paying the cost.
EX12-063.inherited_effect_description_eng: [On Deletion] You may play 1 level 4 or lower [Puppet] or [TB] trait Digimon card from your trash without paying the cost.

EX12-076.effect_description_eng:
＜Rush＞ ＜Raid＞ ＜Blocker＞
[On Play] [When Digivolving] To all of your opponent's Digimon, give -3000 DP for the turn for each color in this Digimon's digivolution cards.
[When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] Place 1 of your opponent's Digimon as the top security card. Then, if this Digimon has 4 or more colors in its digivolution cards, trash their top security card and ＜Recovery +1＞.
(Rule) Trait: Has [Hybrid] Form.
